approach.method_basis: The Parent moves persistent particles through a fixed molecular autoencoder. Each particle retains its current position and velocity, remembers its best actually scored generating position, and is pulled toward that personal best and the best resolved position found by the swarm. A frozen deterministic decoder turns each proposed position into a molecule. Accepted scores update memories only at the exact position that produced their molecular identity. Initially, the encoder supplies particle locations, but an initial molecule can supply a scored attractor only when decoding its encoding reproduces that molecule. In the observed run this worked for just one of the ten supplied molecules.
approach.novelty: Add bounded latent inversion at initialization: move only the input coordinates of each initially mismatched molecule to make its known token sequence preferred by the frozen decoder. Install a refined position only after an exact canonical reconstruction check succeeds, so additional known scores can become usable swarm attractors. Failed refinements retain the original initialization. This is the first Child in the lineage; the Parent tried direct encoder placement but never corrected its coordinates through the decoder. The experiment tests recovery of scored starting positions before proposing any change to the subsequent swarm motion.

observed_bottleneck: The Parent n-9bd1200edbf6 correctly executed persistent swarm motion, exact generating-position score joins and resolved personal/shared memories, but its encoder placed almost all initial observations outside their own deterministic decoder cells. The Parent activation audit and immutable Curate observation report only one identity match out of ten initial molecules per objective: 45 of 50 encoding receipts were mismatches, leaving 90 of 100 particle initializations without scored personal memory. These are repeated measurements of the fixed initial molecule set, not 50 independent reconstruction examples. Greedy heldout canonical reconstruction was only 6/480. The Parent completed its one supplied evaluation with macro score 0.450788797900194; median_2 never exceeded its initial archive incumbent of 0.1678386594791329 while its best actually scored latent position reached only 0.14023138978580565. The identity gate correctly prevented score corruption. The limiting behavior addressed here is the inability to install known scored molecules as exact latent starting positions and attractors; these observations do not prove that more such attractors will improve score or repair the decoder globally.
hypothesis: At objective initialization, refine each identity-mismatched initial encoding by bounded gradient descent on frozen-decoder target-token margin loss, and replace its particle starting position and admit its real initial score only when unchanged deterministic decoding exactly recovers that initial canonical molecule.

finding_summary.headline: One initial molecule became a working swarm attractor, but the macro score fell from 0.451 to 0.348
finding_summary.insights: At least one missing starting identity was already representable by the frozen decoder: correcting its coordinates recovered that identity without changing neural weights or transferring a score to a different molecule. The causal path from recovery to installation, motion and scored attraction is therefore established. That repairs a real coverage defect, but this run does not support the expectation that doubling the initially scored particles improves overall search quality. On drd2_docking and sitagliptin, both recovered personal memories were replaced after their first proposals, before they could supply a nonzero personal pull; their shared memory still influenced other particles. On deco_hop, the recovered shared attractor was referenced in 210 motions and both recovered personal memories survived to the end, yet the task score was lower. The amount of attractor reuse alone is therefore insufficient evidence of useful search guidance. All nine optimization attempts lowered their best visited mean loss, but only one recovered its molecule, so the token-margin proxy cannot replace the production identity check. The eight failures do not establish that those molecules lack an inverse: the bounded local optimizer may simply have failed to find one. Mean decoded fingerprint distance from the source remained large, increasing from 0.854 to 0.864. The molecular assessment likewise finds abundant rings alongside long unsaturated chains, labile polar linkers and irregular ring arrangements. Exact initialization does not control those downstream structural changes. Broader inversion coverage and the usefulness of moves around a recovered position remain separate open questions; this single seed establishes activation and an observed score loss, without establishing a reproducible score effect.
finding_summary.results: Exact starting coverage increased from one to two of the ten supplied molecules. The same additional molecule was recovered in all five objective sessions after 168 latent updates: its mean target-margin loss fell from 0.168312 to 0.019830, and its checked position was installed in two particles per session. This doubled scored initial particle memories from two to four out of twenty. All ten recovered particle copies supplied actual motion sources; their memories produced 44 nonzero personal-attraction terms and 252 nonzero attractions from other particles. Eight other mismatched molecules reached the 256-step limit and retained their original positions, while the original exact match stayed unchanged. These five sessions reuse one fixed ten-molecule set and are not five independent reconstruction tests. The frozen model and exact score-position provenance remained intact. On the supplied seed, the mean final Top-1 score fell from 0.450789 to 0.347733. Zaleplon improved from 0.374833 to 0.390441 and median_2 from 0.167839 to 0.202143; deco_hop fell from 0.592706 to 0.553113, drd2_docking from 0.859171 to 0.412549, and sitagliptin from 0.259395 to 0.180421. Every task completed all 300 evaluations with no invalid or duplicate evaluator submissions.

molecular.headline: Ring-rich aryl and amine outputs still rely on polyenes, labile polar linkers and enlarged heterocycles
molecular.overall_character: The supplied seed-0 trajectories cover all five tasks, each with 300 observed molecules including 290 optimizer proposals. The offspring are mostly medium-sized organic structures with aryl groups, nitrogen/oxygen functionality, nonaromatic unsaturated rings and frequent alkene/imine extensions. The digest ring-closure rates range from 0.9655 to 0.9966, while aromatic-token presence ranges from 0.4621 to 0.8724. These are fractions of proposal strings containing the respective feature, not ring counts or fractions of aromatic atoms. There is substantial variation in connectivity, but recurring polyene, imine and expanded-ring chemistry limits its medicinal-chemistry breadth. Conventional amides, ethers, biaryls and cyclic amines are present; chemically questionable linker and ring contexts often accompany them. All five stereocentre-marker rates are 0.0, although some cited connectivities have unspecified stereogenic centres. The parent comparison shows different chemical families at the score extremes, without establishing which individual structural change caused a score change. The principal missing capability is reliable production of coherent, stable functional-group and ring arrangements; simple ring closure is already abundant.

per_task.generated_character: Relatively compact aryl-containing molecules, with mean SMILES length 38.5; ring-closure and aromatic-token rates are 0.9931 and 0.8724. Phenyl, fluorophenyl, pyridyl and furyl groups occur beside unsaturated nitrogen rings, imines, hydrazone/imidic-acid motifs, ethers and occasional conventional amides. Halogen presence is 0.5138. The highest molecule combines phenyl and fluorophenyl surfaces with an expanded unsaturated nitrogen-containing ring. The elementary functional groups are familiar, but many complete structures would require careful route, tautomer and stability assessment.
liabilities: Terminal methylene imines and extended imine/enamine or vinyl-ether sequences introduce stability and geometric-isomer concerns.

The hydroxy-imine motifs require tautomer assessment; their notation alone does not establish that they are impossible molecules. Large bridged or expanded unsaturated rings also complicate synthesis and conformational control.
missing_features: The low end lacks the compact combination of aryl surface and suitably placed nitrogen/oxygen functionality illustrated by the high end; adding more rings or longer linkers does not supply that balance.

Conventional compact polar scaffolds like the supplied indole carboxamide are not consistently represented among the offspring; many analogous polar features instead sit in imine networks or expanded rings.
per_task.score_gradient_reading: Evaluation 206 scores 0.39044078347364974 and evaluation 104 scores 0.3779644730092272: both combine aryl groups with nitrogen/oxygen functionality in fairly compact structures. The bulky alkyl-linked polycyclic amide at evaluation 27 scores 8.222310670560957e-27 despite carrying rings, aromatics and polar groups. Thus the visible association is with their overall size and arrangement, not the mere presence of those features. The initial indole carboxamide already scores 0.3051048083696145 with more conventional connectivity. Relative to the parent high end, brominated carbonyl/nitrile structures have given way to imine/imidic-acid aryl structures; the observed best changes from 0.37483330611175764 to 0.39044078347364974. The final polyene/vinyl-ether macrocycle at evaluation 300 still scores only 5.749146143478673e-05.

per_task.generated_character: Larger polyunsaturated structures, averaging 53.3 SMILES characters, with ring-closure rate 0.9931 but aromatic-token rate only 0.4621. The upper end includes nitrile-substituted phenyl groups, aryl amines, amides/lactams, methoxy/ethoxy groups and occasional acids. These fragments are often joined through extended conjugated chains or enlarged heterocycles; the highest molecule contains a nitrile-bearing aniline substituent on a large fused unsaturated lactam system. Such topologies are synthetically less straightforward than the recognizable fragments suggest.
liabilities: Long conjugated chains, vinyl ethers and expanded rings create geometric-isomer and conformational questions that the SMILES do not resolve.
Evaluation 238 contains unusual C=[SH] bonding alongside a large imine-rich ring, warranting explicit valence-state and stability assessment before treating it as ordinary synthetic chemistry.
missing_features: Lower-scoring outputs do not retain the linked aryl and polar donor/acceptor contexts recurring in the stronger examples; nonaromatic ring closure alone supplies little discrimination.

Compact, conventional heteroaromatic and carbonyl-ring arrangements are weakly represented in the child upper end compared with the initial examples; the parent also demonstrates an aryl-sulfone chemical family that the child upper end largely omits.
per_task.score_gradient_reading: The high end at evaluation 211 is 0.5531131032788899, whereas the thiophene-linked hydrocarbon polyene at evaluation 281 is 0.5. Other high examples combine aryl nitriles with amide/lactam or amino functionality; ring-rich hydrocarbon and lightly functionalized conjugated structures stay near the 0.5 floor. The score span is narrow, with median 0.506124, and the conventional initial fused carbonyl heterocycle already gives 0.548381482770623. The parent high end instead contains nitrogen-rich aromatic rings, aryl sulfones and linked aryl amines, reaching 0.5927058823529412. The child has fewer aromatic-bearing proposals than the parent and substitutes more polyene/lactam/nitrile chemistry. The final extended lactam polyene scores 0.5028515561349194. These observations do not isolate a uniquely required substructure.

per_task.generated_character: The largest string-size distribution here has mean length 57.8 and maximum 126. Ring-closure and aromatic-token rates are 0.9931 and 0.6931; halogen presence is 0.1448. The strongest structures combine aryl surfaces with aliphatic amine centres, often in enlarged or bridged rings, plus amides, anilines or heteroaromatic nitrogens. The best also bears an aldehyde, a conjugated enamine linker, a phenol and a chlorophenyl group. Much of the remaining set is highly unsaturated and carbonyl-rich, with occasional unusual sulfur/phosphorus or nitrogen-halogen bonding. Overall synthetic plausibility is questionable.
liabilities: Conjugated aldehydes and enamine/imine linkers raise electrophilicity, hydrolysis and isomer-specification concerns, including in the strongest examples.
The late chloramine at evaluation 296 and phosphorus-chloride-containing structure at 295 are reactive functional-group contexts; their accepted scores are not evidence of chemical robustness.
Bridged and enlarged rings often lack stereochemical specification, limiting any confident interpretation of shape or synthetic tractability.
missing_features: Many lower-scoring molecules lack a clearly accessible, non-amide aliphatic amine placed with a suitable aryl surface; merely adding nitrogen, a halogen or an aromatic ring does not reproduce the high-end arrangement.

The child does not consistently retain the relatively simple aminoalkyl-to-aryl organization visible in the stronger parent molecules, instead sampling enamine/aldehyde networks and complicated ring connections.
per_task.score_gradient_reading: The amine-containing aryl macrocycle at evaluation 288 scores 0.4125494085104425, the benzyl-linked polyamine at 262 scores 0.21022146267338043, and the amide-linked bridged amine at 264 scores 0.15946161591325145. The aryl/thiophene imine-lactam at 283 scores 0.00047837097083439295, while the chloramine-containing enal at 296 scores 0.0006956176616831638. Accessible aliphatic amines together with aryl surfaces recur at the upper end, but the initial piperidine-containing hydroxamate is the overall minimum at 0.0003786988088202195: an amine alone is insufficient. The parent high end is dominated by simpler tertiary aminoalkyl arrangements on brominated aromatic/polycyclic cores and reaches 0.8591709360377655. The child high end is more heteroatom-rich and the broader output extends into larger unsaturated structures. This is a structural association, not evidence of a particular binding pose.

per_task.generated_character: The upper end forms a recognizable family of alkoxy/methyl-substituted biaryls attached to N-methyl cyclic amide, urea and amine units. Mean SMILES length is 52.2, with ring-closure rate 0.9966 and aromatic-token rate 0.6517. Some members contain enlarged rings or repeated carbonyl/N-methyl sequences, while the final propoxy-biaryl pyrrolidinone shows a more conventional small saturated lactam. Synthetic plausibility is mixed: the familiar biaryl/ether/lactam pieces are credible, but the large and irregularly connected cyclic derivatives require individual scrutiny.
liabilities: Large rings and repeated N-methyl amide/urea segments create difficult connectivity and conformational-control problems; this does not make every such ring intrinsically unstable.
Stereogenic centres in the cyclic examples, including the final pyrrolidinone, are unspecified. The lower end also contains long cyanopolyene/imine sequences with unresolved alkene geometry.
missing_features: Low-scoring outputs lack the intact alkoxy/methyl biaryl and associated cyclic polar arrangement found repeatedly among the higher-scoring molecules.

The family has limited examples of compact, clearly specified cyclic amide/urea variants without extra carbonyl repeats, large ring expansion or ambiguous stereogenic junctions; the pyrrolidinone shows that conventional ring chemistry is possible.
per_task.score_gradient_reading: The alkoxy-biaryl cyclic urea/amide at evaluation 218 scores 0.20214334360726466, followed by the more heavily carbonylated cyclic analogue at 230 with 0.1990148273435596. The shorter related cyclic carbonyl structure at 260 scores 0.18478728707195913, and the pyrrolidinone at 295 gives 0.17680640316934415. The acyclic cyanopolyene at 126 gives 0.02095188685475281, and the final imine-rich nonaromatic heterocycle at 299 gives 0.04537648504067424. The visible gradient therefore favors the recurring substituted biaryl plus N-methyl/carbonyl context over generic unsaturated nitrogen-containing chains. The parent proposed mainly expanded benzolactam-like high-end structures, with best offspring 0.14023138978580565; its retained initial best was 0.1678386594791329. The child reaches a different, more recurrent biaryl/cyclic-polar motif, without establishing that ring enlargement itself is beneficial.

per_task.generated_character: Moderate-size aryl and heterocyclic structures average 39.1 SMILES characters; ring-closure and aromatic-token rates are 0.9655 and 0.7241. The high-scoring excerpt itself is often nonaromatic: hydroxy cyclopolyenes with imine/enamine and aldehyde groups, an imine-linked nitrogen-rich ring carrying a hydroxy/alkoxy-substituted epoxide, and an acyclic polyimine. A nitrile/acetate-containing fused structure also appears. The lowest examples are bulky unsaturated polycycles with long alkyl sections. The upper-end motifs raise substantial stability and synthetic-route questions despite their moderate size.
liabilities: The top examples repeatedly contain imines, enamines, enols and aldehydes that need tautomer, hydrolysis and reactivity assessment.

Evaluation 267 contains a heavily substituted epoxide, and evaluation 181 contains successive acyl-oxygen/carbonyl linkages alongside a large polyunsaturated ring system; these are substantial stability and synthesis concerns.
Stereogenic epoxide and polycyclic junctions are not specified, and long conjugated chains lack defined alkene geometry.
missing_features: The bulky lower end lacks the moderate size and distributed polar functionality of the stronger examples; the trajectories do not indicate that simply adding aromatic rings repairs this.

Stable, conventional scaffolds expressing the favorable polar-group arrangement are poorly illustrated at the child upper end, where imines, aldehydes and an unusual substituted epoxide dominate. The visible examples do not identify a unique required scaffold.
per_task.score_gradient_reading: The hydroxy unsaturated ring with an imine and aminoaldehyde side chain at evaluation 221 scores 0.18042079374720374. Its related aza-ring analogue at 295 gives 0.07627084463732096, so adding nitrogen does not by itself reproduce the best polar arrangement. The acyclic polyimine at 169 reaches 0.09012237078627712, whereas the large alkyl-rich polycycle at 24 gives 2.126206839959426e-61. The observed separation is mainly compatible with a size/composition and polar-group-arrangement preference; aromaticity is not a sufficient explanation. The digest median is displayed as 0.0 despite the positive reported minimum. Compared with the parent, aromatic-token presence rises from 0.2621 to 0.7241 and ring closure from 0.6759 to 0.9655, but the observed best changes from 0.259395205519374 to 0.18042079374720374. The parent high end was richer in conventional carbonyl/amide functionality; the child favors more imine/enol/aldehyde chemistry.

transferable_gaps.evidence: The proposal ring-closure rates are 0.9655 to 0.9966, yet the digest repeatedly shows enlarged unsaturated nitrogen rings, complex bridged systems and long polyenes attached to otherwise familiar aryl groups. The aryl hydrazone/imidic-acid hit at 0.39044078347364974 and the nitrile-bearing lactam at 0.5531131032788899 both illustrate expanded ring contexts. The biaryl pyrrolidinone at 0.17680640316934415 demonstrates that conventional small saturated ring chemistry is within the observed output.
transferable_gaps.gap: Abundant ring closure is not accompanied by reliable control of ordinary ring topology and molecular size.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: Provide more routine access to coherent aromatic and saturated ring frameworks and chemically controlled changes in ring connectivity and substituent size. Preserve useful aryl and polar fragments while varying their arrangement without automatically extending conjugated chains or enlarging rings. Assess unusual macrocycles and bridged systems individually; their ring-closure syntax alone is neither a quality guarantee nor proof of impossibility.

transferable_gaps.evidence: Terminal imines, imidic-acid/hydrazone forms, enamine-linked aldehydes and vinyl ethers recur in the cited high and low examples. The upper end at 0.4125494085104425 retains an amine/aryl combination but also an aldehyde and conjugated enamine linker. A chloramine-containing enal scores 0.0006956176616831638, and a late proposal contains phosphorus-chloride bonding. Conventional aryl amides, cyclic ureas and a pyrrolidinone elsewhere in the digest provide chemically recognizable alternative contexts.
transferable_gaps.gap: Polar functionality is too often expressed through labile conjugated linkers or unusual reactive bonding contexts.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: Expand coverage of stable amine, amide/urea and ether environments with controlled spacing and substitution, so polar diversity does not require repeated alkene/imine sequences. Treat tautomer/protonation representation separately from genuinely reactive bonds, and apply the same structure-based chemical plausibility criteria to every generated molecule. The observed scores do not establish that replacing a liability will automatically improve an objective.

transferable_gaps.evidence: Every digest task reports stereocentre_rate 0.0. Nevertheless, the cited biaryl pyrrolidinone, substituted epoxide and several bridged cyclic amines contain stereogenic centres without an assigned configuration. The trajectories also show conjugated and substituted alkene sequences without specified geometry.
transferable_gaps.gap: The generator leaves stereogenic connectivity unspecified throughout the observed output.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: Support chemically consistent stereochemical specification when constructing stereogenic centres or configurable double bonds, including preservation of configurations across related structures. This is an observed gap in molecular specification; no supplied comparison establishes a score preference for a particular stereoisomer.

method_name: Molecule Swarm Optimization with persistent latent velocities
method_thesis: Anchor the method in Molecule Swarm Optimization: each particle keeps its latent position, velocity and best observed position, and moves through inertia plus independent stochastic attractions toward its personal best and the swarm's best. [Winter et al., Methods 2.2-2.4](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6836962/) describe this molecular use of particle swarm optimization. For our adaptation, train a compact SELFIES VAE solely on the permitted unlabeled corpus, freeze its encoder and deterministic decoder, and start each objective with clean swarm memories. Encodings of supplied molecules provide starting geometry; their scores initialize attractors only when decoding preserves canonical molecular identity. Otherwise establish scored attractors from actual generated evaluations, never from mislabeled reconstructions. Generate fresh latent positions through particle motion and decode new complete molecules. Locally retry stochastic motion for invalid or duplicate outcomes until the announced batch is filled. Match accepted feedback to the exact generating position before updating personal and shared bests; each batch uses only resolved memories. The corpus supplies a generator, never a molecule library for ranking or retrieval. The hypothesis is that persistent individual trajectories explore alternatives while shared successful locations redirect them quickly enough to improve the mean of independent final Top-1 scores. This uses the provided scalar objective directly, without additional desirability terms. Useful latent geometry and rapid transfer of discoveries between particles remain empirical prerequisites. The published model and evaluation scale do not establish those prerequisites under the permitted preparation and scarce feedback.
